# Final Project: ARIMAX model for Electricity Consumption in Spain

```{r}
serie=window(ts(read.table("ConsumElec.dat"),start=1990,freq=12)) # load time series
plot(serie, main="Gross internal consumption of electrical energy in Spain", ylab="GwH") # plot series
abline(v=1985:2020,lty=3,col=4) # vertical lines per year
serie
lnserie=log(serie) # log-transform
```


```{r}
ultim=c(2018,12) # last training observation
mod1_pdq=c(2,0,1) # arima orders model 1
mod1_PDQ=c(0,1,1) # seasonal orders model 1
mod2_pdq=c(1,0,2) # arima orders model 2
mod2_PDQ=c(0,1,1) # seasonal orders model 2

serie2=window(serie,end=ultim) # training data
lnserie2=log(serie2)
serie1=window(serie,end=ultim+c(1,0)) # includes forecast year
lnserie1=log(serie1)

# fit models to training and full data
(mod1_A=arima(lnserie1,order=mod1_pdq,seasonal=list(order=mod1_PDQ,period=12), include.mean = TRUE))
(mod1_B=arima(lnserie2,order=mod1_pdq,seasonal=list(order=mod1_PDQ,period=12), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod2_A=arima(lnserie1,order=mod2_pdq,seasonal=list(order=mod2_PDQ,period=12), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod2_B=arima(lnserie2,order=mod2_pdq,seasonal=list(order=mod2_PDQ,period=12), include.mean=TRUE))

```
```{r}
mod1_pred=predict(mod1_B,n.ahead=12) # forecast 12 steps
mod1_pr<-ts(c(tail(lnserie2,1),mod1_pred$pred),start=ultim,freq=12) # add last value
mod1_se<-ts(c(0,mod1_pred$se),start=ultim,freq=12) # se for interval

mod2_pred=predict(mod2_B,n.ahead=12)
mod2_pr<-ts(c(tail(lnserie2,1),mod2_pred$pred),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod2_se<-ts(c(0,mod2_pred$se),start=ultim,freq=12)

# transform back and compute intervals
mod1_tl<-ts(exp(mod1_pr-1.96*mod1_se),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod1_tu<-ts(exp(mod1_pr+1.96*mod1_se),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod1_pr<-ts(exp(mod1_pr),start=ultim,freq=12)

mod2_tl<-ts(exp(mod2_pr-1.96*mod2_se),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod2_tu<-ts(exp(mod2_pr+1.96*mod2_se),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod2_pr<-ts(exp(mod2_pr),start=ultim,freq=12)

# plot forecasts and intervals
ts.plot(serie,mod1_tl,mod1_tu,mod1_pr,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=c(2014,2020),type="o",main=paste("Model ARIMA(",paste(mod1_pdq,collapse=","),")(",paste(mod1_PDQ,collapse=","),")12",sep=""))
abline(v=2014:2020,lty=3,col=4)

ts.plot(serie,mod2_tl,mod2_tu,mod2_pr,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=c(2014,2020),type="o",main=paste("Model ARIMA(",paste(mod2_pdq,collapse=","),")(",paste(mod2_PDQ,collapse=","),")12",sep=""))
abline(v=2014:2020,lty=3,col=4)

```
```{r}
(previs=window(cbind(mod1_tl,mod1_pr,mod1_tu,serie,error=round(serie-mod1_pr,3)),start=ultim)) # preview results

obs=window(serie,start=ultim) # actual values

# error metrics model 1
mod1_mod.RMSE1=sqrt(sum((obs-mod1_pr)^2)/12)
mod1_mod.MAE1=sum(abs(obs-mod1_pr))/12
mod1_mod.RMSPE1=sqrt(sum(((obs-mod1_pr)/obs)^2)/12)
mod1_mod.MAPE1=sum(abs(obs-mod1_pr)/obs)/12

# error metrics model 2
mod2_mod.RMSE1=sqrt(sum((obs-mod2_pr)^2)/12)
mod2_mod.MAE1=sum(abs(obs-mod2_pr))/12
mod2_mod.RMSPE1=sqrt(sum(((obs-mod2_pr)/obs)^2)/12)
mod2_mod.MAPE1=sum(abs(obs-mod2_pr)/obs)/12

# display metrics
data.frame("RMSE"=mod1_mod.RMSE1,"MAE"=mod1_mod.MAE1,"RMSPE"=mod1_mod.RMSPE1,"MAPE"=mod1_mod.MAPE1)
data.frame("RMSE"=mod2_mod.RMSE1,"MAE"=mod2_mod.MAE1,"RMSPE"=mod2_mod.RMSPE1,"MAPE"=mod2_mod.MAPE1)

mod1_mCI1=mean(mod1_tu-mod1_tl) # mean ci width model 1
mod2_mCI1=mean(mod2_tu-mod2_tl) # mean ci width model 2

cat("\nMean Length CI mod1: ",mod1_mCI1)
cat("\nMean Length CI mod2: ",mod2_mCI1)

```
```{r}
mod1_pred=predict(mod1_A,n.ahead=12) # forecast using full series
mod1_pr<-ts(c(tail(lnserie1,1),mod1_pred$pred),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod1_se<-ts(c(0,mod1_pred$se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

mod2_pred=predict(mod2_A,n.ahead=12)
mod2_pr<-ts(c(tail(lnserie1,1),mod2_pred$pred),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod2_se<-ts(c(0,mod2_pred$se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

# intervals and back-transform
mod1_tl1<-ts(exp(mod1_pr-1.96*mod1_se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod1_tu1<-ts(exp(mod1_pr+1.96*mod1_se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod1_pr1<-ts(exp(mod1_pr),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

mod2_tl1<-ts(exp(mod2_pr-1.96*mod2_se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod2_tu1<-ts(exp(mod2_pr+1.96*mod2_se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod2_pr1<-ts(exp(mod2_pr),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

# forecast plots next year
ts.plot(serie,mod1_tl1,mod1_tu1,mod1_pr1,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=c(2015,2021),type="o",main=paste("Model ARIMA(",paste(mod1_pdq,collapse=","),")(",paste(mod1_PDQ,collapse=","),")12",sep=""))
abline(v=2015:2021,lty=3,col=4)

ts.plot(serie,mod2_tl1,mod2_tu1,mod2_pr1,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=c(2015,2021),type="o",main=paste("Model ARIMA(",paste(mod2_pdq,collapse=","),")(",paste(mod2_PDQ,collapse=","),")12",sep=""))
abline(v=2015:2021,lty=3,col=4)

```


```{r}
source("CalendarEffects.r") # calendar vars
data=c(start(serie)[1],start(serie)[2], length(serie)) # time info
(wTradDays=Wtrad(data)) # trading days
(wEast=Weaster(data)) # easter var

# arimax models with calendar
(mod1EC=arima(serie,order=c(2,0,1),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays,wEast), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod2EC=arima(serie,order=c(1,0,2),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays,wEast), include.mean=TRUE))

# calendar effect adjustments
mod1_EfecTD=coef(mod1EC)["wTradDays"]*wTradDays
mod1_EfecIN=coef(mod1EC)["wEast"]*wEast
mod1_serieEC=serie-mod1_EfecTD-mod1_EfecIN
plot(mod1_EfecTD+mod1_EfecIN)

mod2_EfecTD=coef(mod2EC)["wTradDays"]*wTradDays
mod2_EfecIN=coef(mod2EC)["wEast"]*wEast
mod2_serieEC=serie-mod2_EfecTD-mod2_EfecIN
plot(mod2_EfecTD+mod2_EfecIN)

plot(serie)
lines(mod1_serieEC,col=2)
lines(mod2_serieEC,col=2)
abline(v=1992:2020,lty=3,col=4)

d1d12mod1_serieEC=diff(diff(mod1_serieEC,12)) # differenced
d1d12mod2_serieEC=diff(diff(mod2_serieEC,12))

```
```{r}
source("atipics2.r") # outlier detection

mod1EC.atip=outdetec(mod1EC,dif=c(1,12),crit=2.8,LS=T)
mod2EC.atip=outdetec(mod2EC,dif=c(1,12),crit=2.8,LS=T)

mod1EC.atip$sigma # variance after correction
mod2EC.atip$sigma

atipics=mod1EC.atip$atip[order(mod1EC.atip$atip[,1]),] # sort
meses=c("Ene","Feb","Mar","Abr","May","Jun","Jul","Ago","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dic")

data.frame(atipics,Fecha=paste(meses[(atipics[,1]-1)%%12+1],start(lnserie)[1]+((atipics[,1]-1)%/%12)),perc.Obs=exp(atipics[,3])*100)

# linearize
serie1.lin=lineal(serie,mod1EC.atip$atip)
serie2.lin=lineal(serie,mod2EC.atip$atip)
d1d12serie1.lin=diff(diff(serie1.lin,12))
d1d12serie2.lin=diff(diff(serie2.lin,12))

# refit models to linearized series
(mod1EC.lin=arima(serie1.lin,order=c(2,0,1),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays,wEast), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod2EC.lin=arima(serie2.lin,order=c(1,0,2),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays,wEast), include.mean=TRUE))

mod1_EfecTD=coef(mod1EC.lin)["wTradDays"]*wTradDays
mod1_EfecIN=coef(mod1EC.lin)["wEast"]*wEast
mod1_serieEC.lin=serie1.lin-mod1_EfecTD-mod1_EfecIN
plot(serie-mod1_serieEC.lin)

mod2_EfecTD=coef(mod2EC.lin)["wTradDays"]*wTradDays
mod2_EfecIN=coef(mod2EC.lin)["wEast"]*wEast
mod2_serieEC.lin=serie2.lin-mod2_EfecTD-mod2_EfecIN
plot(serie-mod2_serieEC.lin)

plot(mod1_serieEC.lin,col=2)
lines(serie)
plot(mod2_serieEC.lin,col=2)
lines(serie)

```


```{r}
ultim=c(2018,12) # forecast point

# windows for model fitting
serie1.lin1=window(serie1.lin,end=ultim+c(1,0))
serie1.lin2=window(serie1.lin,end=ultim)
serie2.lin1=window(serie2.lin,end=ultim+c(1,0))
serie2.lin2=window(serie2.lin,end=ultim)

wTradDays2=window(wTradDays,end=ultim)
wEast2=window(wEast,end=ultim)

# refit models to linearized series
(mod1EC.lin=arima(serie1.lin1,order=c(2,0,1),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays,wEast), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod1EC.lin2=arima(serie1.lin2,order=c(2,0,1),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays2,wEast2), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod2EC.lin=arima(serie2.lin1,order=c(1,0,2),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays,wEast), include.mean=TRUE))
(mod2EC.lin2=arima(serie2.lin2,order=c(1,0,2),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1),period=12),xreg=data.frame(wTradDays2,wEast2), include.mean=TRUE))

```

```{r}
# forecast model 1
mod1_pred=predict(mod1EC.lin2,n.ahead=12,newxreg=window(cbind(wTradDays,wEast),start=c(ultim[1]+1,1)))
mod1_predic=mod1_pred$pr
mod1_wLS=sum(mod1EC.atip$atip[mod1EC.atip$atip$type_detected=="LS" & mod1EC.atip$atip$Obs<=length(serie)-12,3]) # correct level shift
mod1_pr<-ts(c(tail(serie2,1),mod1_predic+mod1_wLS),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod1_se<-ts(c(0,mod1_pred$se),start=ultim,freq=12)

# forecast model 2
mod2_pred=predict(mod2EC.lin2,n.ahead=12,newxreg=window(cbind(wTradDays,wEast),start=c(ultim[1]+1,1)))
mod2_predic=mod2_pred$pr
mod2_wLS=sum(mod2EC.atip$atip[mod2EC.atip$atip$type_detected=="LS" & mod2EC.atip$atip$Obs<=length(serie)-12,3])
mod2_pr<-ts(c(tail(serie2,1),mod2_predic+mod2_wLS),start=ultim,freq=12)
mod2_se<-ts(c(0,mod2_pred$se),start=ultim,freq=12)

# ci bounds
mod1_tl<-ts(mod1_pr-1.96*mod1_se,start=ultim,freq=12)
mod1_tu<-ts(mod1_pr+1.96*mod1_se,start=ultim,freq=12)
mod1_pr<-ts(mod1_pr,start=ultim,freq=12)

mod2_tl<-ts(mod2_pr-1.96*mod2_se,start=ultim,freq=12)
mod2_tu<-ts(mod2_pr+1.96*mod2_se,start=ultim,freq=12)
mod2_pr<-ts(mod2_pr,start=ultim,freq=12)

# plot forecasts
ts.plot(serie,mod1_tl,mod1_tu,mod1_pr,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=ultim[1]+c(-3,2),type="o",main="Model ARIMA(2,0,1)(0,1,1)12+TD+IC+Outliers")
abline(v=(ultim[1]-3):(ultim[1]+2),lty=3,col=4)
ts.plot(serie,mod2_tl,mod2_tu,mod2_pr,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=ultim[1]+c(-3,2),type="o",main="Model ARIMA(1,0,2)(0,1,1)12+TD+IC+Outliers")
abline(v=(ultim[1]-3):(ultim[1]+2),lty=3,col=4)

```

```{r}
obs=window(serie,start=ultim) # actual 2019

# model 1 errors
mod1.RMSE3=sqrt(sum((obs-mod1_pr)^2)/12)
mod1.MAE3=sum(abs(obs-mod1_pr))/12
mod1.RMSPE3=sqrt(sum(((obs-mod1_pr)/obs)^2)/12)
mod1.MAPE3=sum(abs(obs-mod1_pr)/obs)/12

# model 2 errors
mod2.RMSE3=sqrt(sum((obs-mod2_pr)^2)/12)
mod2.MAE3=sum(abs(obs-mod2_pr))/12
mod2.RMSPE3=sqrt(sum(((obs-mod2_pr)/obs)^2)/12)
mod2.MAPE3=sum(abs(obs-mod2_pr)/obs)/12

# show results
data.frame("RMSE"=mod1.RMSE3,"MAE"=mod1.MAE3,"RMSPE"=mod1.RMSPE3,"MAPE"=mod1.MAPE3)
data.frame("RMSE"=mod2.RMSE3,"MAE"=mod2.MAE3,"RMSPE"=mod2.RMSPE3,"MAPE"=mod2.MAPE3)

```

```{r}
data3=c(ultim[1]+2, 1, 12) # forecast 2020
wTradDays3=Wtrad(data3) # td 2020
wEast3=Weaster(data3) # easter 2020

# model 1 forecast 2020
mod1_pred=predict(mod1EC.lin,n.ahead=12,newxreg=data.frame(wTradDays3,wEast3))
mod1_predic=mod1_pred$pr
mod1_wLS=sum(mod1EC.atip$atip[mod1EC.atip$atip$type_detected=="LS",3])
mod1_pr<-ts(c(serie[length(serie)],mod1_predic+mod1_wLS),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod1_se<-ts(c(0,mod1_pred$se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

# model 2 forecast 2020
mod2_pred=predict(mod2EC.lin,n.ahead=12,newxreg=data.frame(wTradDays3,wEast3))
mod2_predic=mod2_pred$pr
mod2_wLS=sum(mod2EC.atip$atip[mod2EC.atip$atip$type_detected=="LS",3])
mod2_pr<-ts(c(serie[length(serie)],mod2_predic+mod2_wLS),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod2_se<-ts(c(0,mod2_pred$se),start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

# prediction intervals
mod1_tl3<-ts(mod1_pr-1.96*mod1_se,start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod1_tu3<-ts(mod1_pr+1.96*mod1_se,start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod1_pr3<-ts(mod1_pr,start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

mod2_tl3<-ts(mod2_pr-1.96*mod2_se,start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod2_tu3<-ts(mod2_pr+1.96*mod2_se,start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)
mod2_pr3<-ts(mod2_pr,start=ultim+c(1,0),freq=12)

# forecast plot 2020
ts.plot(serie,mod1_tl3,mod1_tu3,mod1_pr3,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=ultim[1]+c(-2,3),type="o",main="Model ARIMA(2,0,1)(0,1,1)12+CE+IA+Outliers")
abline(v=(ultim[1]-2):(ultim[1]+3),lty=3,col=4)

ts.plot(serie,mod2_tl3,mod2_tu3,mod2_pr3,lty=c(1,2,2,1),col=c(1,4,4,2),xlim=ultim[1]+c(-2,3),type="o",main="Model ARIMA(2,0,1)(0,1,1)12+CE+IA+Outliers")
abline(v=(ultim[1]-2):(ultim[1]+3),lty=3,col=4)

```
